theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cttp_planar_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (p : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), p ≠ 0 → IsMinimizingIn S univ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ y ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {p}, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ (w : Euclid P) (θ' : ℝ), HasMassDensity S w θ' → HasMassDensity S (y + lam • w) θ') → 1 ≤ θ → HasMassDensity S 0 θ → ∃ τ : Fin 2 → Euclid P, Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧ p ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) ∧ S.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))
